# Verdicts

Every way a Proof can end, so you can trust what a report tells you.

A Proof passes, fails, errors, or never gets prepared. The ones here show each
verdict, how a [budget](verdicts/budget) reads the trace, and what a
[critical](verdicts/critical) Proof looks like. A run that
[keeps a resource open](verdicts/passed) until Verification ends passes.
